verdict.rationale: Capacities has typed objects with custom properties (docs-26, docs-29), and the pricing page lists "Smart queries" as a feature (docs-27), which points to a first-party property-query capability. Its existence is evidenced but its depth is not. The export docs mention "collections" (docs-31), but nothing describes how queries filter on properties or how results render as live views. missing for 10: documentation of how smart queries filter by structured properties, evidence of live table/board/list views rendered from query results, hands-on or independent corroboration.
